pages.text: $(thing)Abomination$() is an element of its own, drawn from the parasites themselves.$(br2)Its spells answer only to Living and Sentient wands and spellblades, or to a focus carrying the $(item)Adaptation Upgrade$(). Any other focus refuses to cast them.
Abomination spectral dust comes mainly from corrupted wizards, and can also be crafted from parasite remains. It lights the receptacles of the Nine Altars.
